note: Construction sites of every Deep Frontier building (docs/asset-pipeline.md, 'Construction stages'). Native mechanism (Timberborn 1.1.2.8, decompiled ConstructionSiteProgressVisualizer): the direct children of BuildingModelSpec.UnfinishedModelName are stages, child 0 the ConstructionBase shown until the first material arrives, then the last stage whose ProgressThreshold the build progress has reached. Every vanilla Iron Teeth workshop has a nested vanilla ConstructionBase<X>x<Y> plus one ConstructionStage0 (a dark timber or BaseMetal frame on a Dirt patch) and ProgressThresholds [0.0]. tools/asset-pipeline/build_construction_stages.py generates each stage from the building's blocks and finished model (construction_stage_massing.py, construction_stage_geometry.py) into exportRoot; tools/construction_stage_content.mjs binds the base and the stage at the end of canonical generation; tools/asset-pipeline/validate_construction_exports.py checks them.

vanillaBases.note: Plain vanilla ConstructionBases (vendor Resources/ConstructionBases), nested like vanilla blueprints; the largest that fits on grounded cells, centred, offset by Modification.TransformSpec as vanilla MetalPlatform3x3 and LargeWaterWheel do. WithoutCorners bases need their non-corner cells grounded.

authored.FisherFlag: Authored native stage (fisher_flag_geometry.build_stage: landing, post stumps, the pole lying on the boards) with the vanilla ConstructionBase1x1, as the vanilla Gatherer Flag it is cloned from.

previewOnly.SteelLegDeck: Tool templates SteelLegDeck<n>x<n>H<k> are only placement previews: SteelDeckPlacer (Scripts/SteelStructures/SteelLegDecks.cs) builds native SteelColumnH* and SteelDeck entities instead, which carry their own construction stages. The template's #Unfinished names the SteelDeck stage and is never shown.
